rationale: Add default-fatal numerical-error classification to fused and constrained targets. Native transforms, compiled arithmetic and the exact core distribution Numerical variant explicitly opt in; integrators report a numerical divergence for those proposal failures while direct evaluation, initialization, structural errors and foreign backend errors retain their typed failures. No density, gradient, numerical tolerance or adaptation policy change. Also add opt-in version-one point-estimation JSON export with explicit caller assessment encoding, provenance/counter/stopping validation and no new statistical claims; the existing numerical classifier review remains intact. Add explicit Faer-gated observed-likelihood HVP information and chart covariance with symmetry/conditioning/positivity checks, no numerical repair or interval claims. The new runtime+faer inventory bootstraps from the previously feature-neutral default runtime endpoint; removing only the new information namespace reproduces that baseline exactly. Gaussian interval increment adds explicit-policy marginal Student-t intervals for declared fixed-design homoskedastic Gaussian regression and one-SVD residual covariance. The new LeastSquaresError::RankDeficient variant and method additions are potentially breaking pre-alpha additions, explicitly adjudicated here; prior decisions and the original baseline are preserved. Numerical/source/item qualification stays research-only, with no general coverage or performance promotion. The additional LeastSquaresError::Covariance variant preserves the original Cholesky pivot/source instead of erasing it into Numerical; its enum/member additions are also explicitly covered by this pre-alpha decision. Enzyme adapters now override the existing numerical-error hooks for their own NonFinite variant; direct and curvature errors remain typed. The two rendered overrides are covered by this same pre-alpha review against the original baseline, with no maturity promotion. Modeling ergonomics adds checked ScalarInput conversion, literal/handle arithmetic, named native distribution conveniences and a facade-only construction macro. Generic constructor signature replacements and new methods/types/trait are explicitly reviewed pre-alpha changes against the same original baseline. Graph arithmetic, statistical roles, typed scale constraints, Jacobians and errors remain explicit; no method-maturity promotion or speed claim. Semantic primitive increment adds immutable typed descriptors, argument/event/batch/measure signatures, cold graph and selected-view source-capability inspection, and scoped Rust component composition. Native normal and normal regression lower to the existing kernels and Jacobian boundary. New types, trait implementations and builder methods are explicitly reviewed against the same original baseline as pre-alpha additions, without a compatibility-policy waiver or numerical/performance maturity promotion. Tensor/control-flow increment adds fixed-shape deterministic block SSA regions, immutable bindings and consuming primitive rebinding, explicit batch/source rule hooks and native link-regression descriptors. MissingPointwise is an explicitly reviewed enum addition against the same original baseline. These are pre-release research interfaces, not a compatible-series waiver, speed or higher-derivative maturity promotion. Workspace-explicit density/objective source exporters and the defaulted Primitive::source_workspace hook are explicitly reviewed pre-release additions against the same original baseline. Typed external float buffers and explicit zero HVP-direction tangents repair the matrix compiler failure and incorrect scan third derivatives; default executed bounded fixtures do not qualify arbitrary compiler programs or statistical tensor workloads, and do not promote maturity. Native regression CPU plans add inspected immutable dispatch metadata and explicit scalar diagnostics through the existing descriptors. New plan types and methods are reviewed pre-release additions against the same original baseline. Cached automatic dispatch retains existing kernels, numerical validation and default policy; no cost-model, threading, compatibility or performance/maturity promotion is implied. Automatic regression plans additionally expose is_scalar_for_shape and use existing scalar kernels when neither a full observation tile nor a coefficient packet exists. Wider normal fallbacks remain unchanged. The new method is explicitly reviewed against the original baseline, with no fitted cost model or maturity promotion. Vertical integration adds explicit batch-row predictive partitions and opt-in analysis manifest v3 (whole-factor v2 unchanged), shared prepared regression data/response replacement and specialized batch workspace hooks, native real-coefficient GLM potential HVP targets, typed affine observation map/law/sum lowering, and explicit tensor workspace admission budgets. New public declarations are reviewed pre-release additions against the same original baseline; no generic graph Hessian, arbitrary closure fusion, statistical coverage, speed or maturity promotion is implied. Add opt-in TensorBuilder::checkpointed_scan: native segmented reverse storage with replay; ordinary scan keeps retained frames. Same mathematical/source semantics, no default performance or GPU promotion. Add the explicit first-order source-checkpoint lowering hook, reviewed against the original baseline without maturity promotion. General tensor pointwise fusion preserves reverse order; source HVP and third-order tapes remain compiler-owned. Explicit native tensor matrix execution adds checked Faer/LP64 BLAS adapters, an opt-in kernel policy and builder method, without changing default compensated execution. New methods, non-exhaustive policy members and re-exports are reviewed pre-release additions against the same original baseline, not a maturity or general speed promotion. External provider scratch/threading and scalar source-export differences are disclosed; core+faer is checked against the same API-neutral core inventory. Availability-only MatrixKernel::Auto, resolved and lexical builder policy are reviewed research additions, not fitted scheduling, numerical equivalence or maturity promotion.
